source.note: eSignet 2.x documentation. The shape is from documentation and was not observed. The access token follows RFC 9068 with sub, iss, aud, exp, iat, client_id and scope. The header typ is not stated. at+jwt is inferred from the RFC and is not documented.

notes: The issuer is a literal. A product trusts one configured issuer and never an eSignet issuer.
